dedupeText: retro radio lounge graphic retro lounge gradient oval logo vertical sidebar purple and blue 2000s aesthetic vertical sidebar vs expansive main field warm orange red sidebar vs cool blue purple main area large centered oval emblem as the primary focal point secondary vertical text aligned to the left margin combine a color a to color b gradient background with a contrast color vertical sidebar anchor the composition with a large shape containing custom lettering style in the center right

recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition layout featuring a narrow vertical sidebar on the left with warm, textured imagery and a dominant right section with a deep blue-to-purple gradient background, anchored by a large, stylized oval typographic emblem.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical sidebar vs. expansive main field
Warm orange/red sidebar vs. cool blue/purple main area
Large centered oval emblem as the primary focal point
Secondary vertical text aligned to the left margin
coreInvariants: Deep blue-to-black radial or linear gradient background
A thick-bordered oval containing integrated custom lettering
A distinct vertical divider separating a photographic strip from the main graphic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large oval emblem occupies the upper two-thirds of the right panel; a vertical text block runs along the left sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large purple and white oval emblem in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large central emblem, move left to the vertical sidebar, and then down to the blurred foreground elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the bottom right to provide contrast for the emblem.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue and royal purple gradients for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and lavender for the central emblem and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange, amber, and red tones within the left sidebar imagery.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and purples; high value contrast between the white text and dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sans-serif with heavy weights and geometric curves.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are integrated into the oval shape
Variable stroke widths with sharp, tapered terminals
Overlapping characters to create a unified mark
Numbers are blocky and squared off
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features a long, sweeping tail that forms part of the oval's inner curve
Lowercase letters are tightly kerned and nested under the larger initials
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, custom-drawn emblem paired with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif for metadata.

preserve: Oval containment of the main logo
avoid: Bright green or yellow primary colors

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy, condensed feel of the numbers in the emblem.
For the clean, vertical sidebar text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a background with a deep navy-to-purple gradient. On the far left, include a narrow vertical strip containing a warm-toned, blurred image of a lounge interior with amber lighting. Add soft, out-of-focus white bokeh shapes in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large purple oval with a thick white border in the center-right. Inside the oval, add custom heavy sans-serif lettering that follows the curve of the oval. Along the left sidebar, add vertical white sans-serif text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the main emblem contained within an oval?
Is the color palette dominated by blue and purple?
Is there a clear contrast between the warm sidebar and cool main area?

mustRedesign: Exact lounge photography in the sidebar

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the gradient
Clean, sharp edges on the central emblem

postGenerationChecks: Check that the oval is not distorted into a circle.
Ensure the sidebar divider is a clean vertical line.
Verify the purple hue is vibrant and not desaturated.
Confirm the vertical text is aligned to the left edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color A] to [Color B] gradient background with a [Contrast Color] vertical sidebar. Anchor the composition with a large [Shape] containing [Custom Lettering Style] in the center-right.
